in_marathi.name: Pitamber
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Treasures
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pitamber हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Pitamber is derived from two Sanskrit words - Pita (Father) and Ambar (Sky or Treasure). This name is believed to represent the God who holds the treasures of the universe in his arms. It is a revered name among Hindus and is often given to boys as a mark of respect and devotion.
